justification: Emit stages are filesystem adapters: they materialise pipeline output on disk. The first-party forme-emit-fs sink declares filesystem:write in this audit inventory and writes through node:fs/promises directly, matching forme-source-fs's implementation boundary. FM02's shipped capability-backed APIs separately mediate installed third-party plugins, so this stage is an explicit filesystem implementation rather than a consumer of ambient plugin authority. The boundary is documented in the README and source header.
